notes.title: Release Date Pushed Back!
notes.notes:
Hello Friends, I pushed back the release date.  Well, more to the point, I missed the target I set for myself back in September, obviously.  

I had just set up the Steam Store and I was all full of piss and vinegar and gumption, and I said, YEUP, LET'S SEND THIS PUPPY OUT IN TWO WEEKS!

And in two weeks time, I knew it wasn't a great idea, so I scrapped a bunch of my most recent changes and took a step back to examine the scope of the project.  

I'm only telling you about it NOW is because I am fully prepared to commit to the NEW release date of Spooky Halloween: October 31!

Will the product be ready by Halloween?  Maybe!  I'm not a fortune teller, and anything is possible!   What I CAN tell you with a high degree of certainty that I will push SOMETHING to the store before Nov 1.  Will it be too late for you to get a spooky Halloween scare?  Maybe.  If you're still reading this, just admit to yourself you are as committed to playing this game as I am to making it, and you will stick it out as long as it takes to get something good.  

Hey, at least I'm ahead of Star Citizen, and I don't even have 68 million in donations!
